x: Special mention should also be made of Archie Bedford on his most welcome return to form, and of a fine performance by young Radford. The handicap was won by Ken Stimpson who produced a time considerably faster than his usual.
After an initial impetuous run by Brian Johnstone, the battle developed between the Bird brothers (Ranelagh) and a Herne Hill pair. First Belgrave pair home were Johnstone and Radford.

Normally our middle-distance men could have split forces but on this occasion we had Newell, Robinson, Dabbs and Radford on holiday, Davies injured and Bhatia a 'flu victim; so it was decided to concentrate our remaining forces on the only major road-relay event we tackle before the "Brighton".
11th Stage.Jim Radford (21.25) This was Jim's first taste of the Brighton road and although his time of 21mins25secs was not outstanding he can be well pleased with his initial run in bad conditions.
Although we will be without Bhatia and Roffey next time we have good substitutes in Miller, Radford and David Jones, and can expect Jack Brown to be fitter and Ron Linstead to take a longer leg.

We might even discover a potential Radford, Cooper or Lucking in this way. Wishing you all the best and plenty of medals in the weeks to come,
